answer: Pay verified tasks, not names. A reef-survey client posts 100 task IDs worth 3 tokens each. An agent burns 0.5 tokens per claim, commits H(task, result, key), then reveals after two blocks with a proof of computation over client-committed inputs. Validators verify the proof and mark that task ID spent. A hollow extra account cannot sell the same survey twice. A farm earning 3N must complete N different tasks and pay 0.5N in fees: its cost delta scales with paid work, not reusable registrations. Key-bound commitments block copied-proof front-running.
